If you loved Dear Debbie by Freida McFadden and Don't Let Him In by Lisa Jewell, you will be totally obsessed with The New Tenant! This completely shocking and explosive novel will keep you up all night.

'Buckle up and enjoy the ride' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'Left me breathless.' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'An edge-of-your-seat read.' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
'A gripping page turner.' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

Eliza Curran has it all.

Each day she wakes up to a life others dream of – cooking in her stunning home, eating breakfast with her beloved children, kissing her wealthy, adoring husband as he leaves for work...

But her reality is a nightmare.

She is trapped in a marriage with a controlling man. Their beautiful house is her prison.

When a new tenant moves in he thinks he can save her.

But he’s too late.

He doesn’t understand why Eliza stays. Because when you have as many secrets as she does, you’ll do anything to keep them hidden.

Everyone is talking about The New Tenant...

'A masterclass in domestic noir - I loved it.' ANDREA MARA
